findings.issue: Common noun הָאָבִיב (H24, article + common noun, not a proper name) is left untranslated as Aviv.
tiempo flattens מוֹעֵד (appointed time) to generic time.
Adverb רֵיקָם is rendered as the adjective vacíos, attaching emptiness to the faces.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens in person, number, and participants.
